title: Greer's CE5 coherent thought sequencing

tellings.quote: According to Greer, the craft picks up on a directed coherent thought signal as clearly as a radio would pick up on an electromagnetic signal.

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher, runs a practice called CE5, short for "close encounters of the fifth kind", in which people try to call in craft with their minds. According to Greer, the craft pick up "a directed coherent thought signal as clearly as a radio would pick up on an electromagnetic signal." Michels lays out Greer's idea in an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor; if true, it would mean contact can be made by thought alone.
